      Licences

      • Code: GPL-3.0. The source is openly available on GitHub.
      • Collector images: CC BY-NC 4.0, reuse with attribution, non-commercial.
      • Ship renders in the catalogue and beginner mode: property of Cloud Imperium, sourced via the RSI Ship Matrix and the Star Citizen Wiki (starcitizen.tools) and used under the fan site rules.
      • Ship data: Star Citizen Wiki API (api.star-citizen.wiki).
      • Icons: Lucide, ISC licence, © Lucide Icons and Contributors.
      • Font: Xharig Sans, a subset of Lato (© Łukasz Dziedzic), SIL Open Font License 1.1.

      Privacy

      • This site sets no cookies and stores no IP addresses.
      • Your progress lives only in your browser (localStorage) and never leaves it.
      • Counting happens without any identifier, only "how many": page views, started and finished runs, results, which ships get confused, reported images, language, device type (phone or PC), the referring site and the country Cloudflare derives from the request. Nobody can be recognised from this.
      • The site is hosted on GitHub Pages; counting runs on Cloudflare.
